source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including all written/read and other notes, not normalized reconstructions.
source.public_versification_note: Public Joshua 18–24 and Hebrew source references align one to one. All 216 original source records are bound exactly once.

key_decisions.decision: Render Geliloth as districts, keep Canaan and Jordan references, and preserve the conspicuous size without locating a bank by conjecture.
Keep the report’s geographical language in its own voice without harmonizing it to the narrator’s preceding description.
Keep actual preparations for violence against fellow Israelites explicit.
Keep breach of faith and rebellion as the delegation’s charge, with repeated today and no narrator endorsement added.
Preserve continuing communal guilt, lack of cleansing and plague rather than treating the incident as fully past.
Keep the today/tomorrow warning and collective consequences.
Retain the conditional impurity claim, concrete offer to share land and alleged rebellion against both God and community.
Preserve the compressed ancestry and argument from collective harm without adding unstated guilty parties.
Retain both triple divine invocations and the abrupt second-person appeal, with its referent noted as uncertain.
Keep the conditional denial, three offering categories and invoked divine judgment.
Preserve the named tribes in the imagined exclusion and the claimed effect on later generations.
Retain altar-as-witness, generational continuity, three offerings and the repeated exclusion formula.
Preserve the strong denial and every offering type without changing it into the narrator’s judgment.
Retain the inference of divine presence and striking rescue-from-the-LORD image.
Keep blessing God and abandonment of the stated destructive war plan.
Supply Witness as an implied name with an explicit note that the pinned Hebrew does not separately state it.
